scene: The opened dryer unfolds into a radiant station portal of three routes.
picture: A flat side view along a wide platform. On the far left, the open silver subway train waits on rails. The player in yellow raincoat, afro, green boots, and red umbrella stands left-centre. In the centre, a yellow street tram idles. On the far right, a turquoise ferry floats by a wooden pier.
shown: a sleek silver subway train waiting with open doors on the left track
a bright yellow street tram idling with headlights on at the centre platform
a turquoise harbour ferry bobbing gently at the right pier with lowered ramp

variants.scene: You step onto a quiet station platform where three different rides await.
Water laps against the wooden dock as warm station lamps glow overhead.
Humming tracks and rippling waves call you forward on your search for {quest}.
